about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer based in Casablanca, working at KAY Technology on enterprise applications used by real teams every day. My work sits where business complexity meets the interface: logistics, operations, reporting.
about.p2: I care about the details most people scroll past — the empty state, the loading behavior, the data table that stays readable with five hundred rows. Software earns trust in those details.
about.p3: Most of my days are spent between Vue 3 frontends and Java backends, turning business requirements into systems that stay maintainable long after the first release.

page.title: About
page.p1: I'm Soufiane NAMOUHI, a full-stack web developer from Casablanca, Morocco. Since earning my DTS diploma in 2021, I've been building business software professionally at KAY Technology — enterprise platforms where data density, workflow logic and long-term maintainability are the real requirements.
page.p2: My specialty is the middle ground between disciplines: complex Vue 3 interfaces on one side, Java and Spring Boot services on the other, and the API contract that keeps them honest. I've built customer portals, delivery and mission management tools, and reporting pipelines that turn live data into printable, decision-ready documents.
page.p3: What I enjoy most is the problem-solving layer — taking a business process that lives in spreadsheets and conversations, and giving it a structure that survives contact with real users. I'm skeptical of hype, fond of typed contracts, and convinced that reliability is a feature.
page.p4: Outside production work, I explore Flutter for mobile, Unity for interactive 3D, and AI-assisted development workflows — always looking for ways to build faster without building worse.
